'''Boucar Diouf''' (born 26 May 1965 in [[Fatick]], [[Senegal]]) is a [[biologist]], [[oceanographer]] and [[comedian]] of Senegalese origin based in [[Quebec]].<ref>{{cite web |title=La nouvelle génération nous donne un coup de vieux ! |url=https://www.lavoixdelest.ca/2022/10/15/la-nouvelle-generation-nous-donne-un-coup-de-vieux--6dceccdbbe6d0076423c0422b139564c |website=La Voix de l'Est |date=2022-10-15 |access-date=2023-04-14}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Boucar Diouf |url=https://www.thecanadianencyclopedia.ca/fr/article/boucar-diouf |website=thecanadianencyclopedia.ca |access-date=2023-04-14}}</ref> He moved to Quebec in 1991 to pursue graduate studies at [[Rimouski]], where he briefly taught biology at the [[Université du Québec à Rimouski]]. He now works as a comedian, columnist, and radio host.

His [[stand-up comedy|sketches]] often focus on issues of immigrant [[Social integration|integration]], life in [[Africa]], and cultural differences.

== Biography ==
After undergraduate and graduate studies in [[biology]] at [[Cheikh Anta Diop University]] in [[Dakar]], Diouf earned a [[PhD]] in [[oceanography]] from the [[Université du Québec à Rimouski]] (UQAR).<ref>{{cite book |last1=Diouf |first1=Boucar |title=Les facteurs de résistance au froid de l'éperlan arc-en-ciel (Osmerus mordax) et leur influence sur sa biochimie postmortem à deux stades de développement (juvénile et adulte) |publisher=PhD thesis, Université du Québec à Rimouski |location=Rimouski, Quebec |year=1997}}</ref> He then taught biology at UQAR, working on practical teaching methods in [[animal physiology]].<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Diouf|first1=Boucar|last2=Rioux|first2=Pierre|last3=Blier|first3=Pierre U.|last4=Rajotte|first4=Denis|title=Use of brook char (Salvelinus fontinalis) physiological responses to stress as a teaching exercise|journal=Advances in Physiology Education|year=2000|volume=23|issue=1|pages=18–23|url=http://advan.physiology.org/content/23/1/18.reprint}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|last1=Diouf|first1=Boucar|last2=Rioux|first2=Pierre|title=Use of the Rigor Mortis Process as a Tool for Better Understanding of Skeletal Muscle Physiology: Effect of Ante-Mortem Stress on the Progression of Rigor Mortis in Brook Charr (Salvelinus fontinalis)|journal=The American Biology Teacher|year=1999|volume=61|issue=5|pages=376–379|doi=10.2307/4450701}}</ref> To make his lectures easier to understand, he created humorous capsules called “Boucardises.” It was his students who signed him up for auditions at the Just for Laughs festival.

From 2006 onward, he hosted several television shows. Between 2014 and 2023, he hosted the Radio-Canada program ''La nature selon Boucar'' before a live audience of 40 people.<ref>{{cite web|title=De retour sur ICI Radio-Canada Première – La nature selon Boucar|website=Info Culture|date=2015-04-09|url=https://info-culture.biz/2015/04/09/de-retour-sur-ici-radio-canada-premiere-la-nature-selon-boucar/}}</ref><ref>[https://ici.radio-canada.ca/ohdio/premiere/emissions/2736/la-nature-selon-boucar 96 episodes available online at Radio-Canada.]</ref> He also occasionally takes part in public debates, speaking out on issues such as [[systemic racism]]<ref>{{cite web|last=Diouf|first=Boucar|title=Le mot en " s " pour systémique |url=https://www.lapresse.ca/debats/opinions/2021-02-20/le-mot-en-s-pour-systemique.php |date=2021-02-20 |website=La Presse}}</ref> and the low acceptance rate by Ottawa of students from French-speaking Africa.<ref>{{cite web|last=Girard|first=Jean-Yves|title=Un riz frit avec Boucar Diouf|url=https://lactualite.com/culture/un-riz-frit-avec-boucar-diouf/ |website=L'Actualité|date=October 2023|page=69}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* 2005: Revelation of the Year, Grand Rire de Québec
* 2006: Jacques-Couture Award – from the Ministry of Immigration and Cultural Communities  
* 2011: Mérite du Français en éducation, from the Association des professeurs de français du Québec  
* 2011: Prix nez d'or, Grand Rire de Québec festival  
* 2013: Charles-Biddle Award, Government of Quebec  
* 2014: Pierre Dansereau Award, Association des biologistes du Québec  
* 2016: Knight of the [[National Order of Quebec]], presented by Premier [[Philippe Couillard]]  
* 2019: Medal of Honour of the National Assembly of Quebec<ref>{{cite web |title=Récipiendaires de la Médaille d'honneur de l'Assemblée nationale - Assemblée nationale du Québec |url=https://www.assnat.qc.ca/fr/abc-assemblee/assemblee-nationale/medailles-assemblee-nationale/medailles-honneur-assemblee-nationale.html |website=www.assnat.qc.ca |access-date=2024-06-06}}</ref>  
* 2021: Honorary doctorate, [[Université Laval]]
